scenes.title: Uninformed 'Suproxin' student tossing paper airplanes beside a euphoric confederate while his hands tremble from adrenaline
scenes.era: 1962, University of Minnesota waiting room, Minneapolis

layout.description: Brightly lit 1962 university waiting room with a wooden table stacked with scratch paper and manila folders, a metal wire wastebasket in the corner, a plastic hula hoop leaning against the wall, and a one-way observation window.

positions.who: Euphoric Confederate (mannequin in 1962 cardigan and rolled sleeves)
positions.where: standing dynamically launching a folded white paper airplane across the room toward the wire wastebasket

positions.who: Epi-Ignorant Subject (mannequin in 1962 collared shirt with rolled left sleeve showing small bandage)
positions.where: rising eagerly from his chair with visibly trembling adrenaline-charged hands to fold and launch his own paper airplane

props.name: small adhesive injection bandage & 'Suproxin' vial tray
props.period_detail: 1960s medical tray by the door holding a labeled 'Suproxin' bottle while a tiny round bandage sits on the student's upper arm
props.physical_behavior: marks the hidden 0.5 cc epinephrine injection

props.name: folded white paper airplanes & crumpled paper balls
props.period_detail: crisp white scratch-paper darts arcing across the waiting room toward a wire wastebasket
props.physical_behavior: launched gleefully by the uninformed student who misreads his racing heart as euphoria

props.name: pulse recording chart behind glass
props.period_detail: clipboard behind the one-way window logging identical elevated pulse rates across groups
props.physical_behavior: proves bodily arousal matched while behavior diverged

actions.verb_sequence: glances down at his unexplained trembling hands -> watches the confederate sail a paper airplane -> grins posture-wide and launches his own paper dart across the room
compares the wild euphoria tally (22.56) against the calm Informed student's sheet (12.72)

reactions.reaction: scoops up another sheet of scratch paper, interpreting raw adrenaline as pure fun
cheers him on beside the manila-folder tower

scenes.wardrobe: 1962 Midwestern collegiate attire: Oxford shirts with one sleeve rolled to show small round arm bandage, V-neck sweaters, chinos, loafers.
scenes.recognition_hook: Injected with secret adrenaline and given zero explanation for his pounding heart, a college student joins a stranger in hurling paper airplanes across the waiting room.

key_visual.description: two 1962 male college mannequins in a cluttered university waiting room launching folded white paper airplanes toward a wire wastebasket while one wears an arm injection bandage

scenes.title: Epi-Informed student sits calmly immune to the paper airplanes

layout.description: Same waiting room with paper airplanes on the floor while an Informed student sits relaxed in his chair pointing calmly to the bandage on his arm.

positions.where: leaning back calmly in his wooden chair watching a paper airplane land beside him without joining in

props.name: side-effect briefing card
props.period_detail: printed physician note listing 'pounding heart and hand tremor'
props.physical_behavior: gives the brain the true cause of arousal

actions.verb_sequence: feels his pulse race -> touches his arm bandage knowingly -> stays calmly seated

reactions.reaction: watches the actor's hula-hoop routine with mild detached amusement

scenes.recognition_hook: Warned for twenty seconds that the shot causes a racing heart, the Informed student stays completely immune.

scenes.title: Same adrenaline dose flips into anger in the questionnaire room

layout.description: Same table now holding thick five-page stapled questionnaires as the confederate rips his pages in half.

positions.where: standing beside the table tearing the five-page questionnaire in half
pushing his own questionnaire away sharply in shared indignation

props.name: five-page personal questionnaire
props.period_detail: stapled mimeographed booklet torn down the center
props.physical_behavior: channels unexplained adrenaline into shared anger

actions.verb_sequence: rips his booklet and tosses it into the basket -> Uninformed subject slams his pencil down in agreement

reactions.reaction: bristles with borrowed outrage fueled by the exact same 0.5 cc epinephrine shot

scenes.recognition_hook: Swap the actor's script, and the exact same 0.5 cc shot of adrenaline turns into anger instead of joy.

scenes.title: Checking the espresso cup before blaming a frustrating email

layout.description: Bright modern desk with a laptop and TWO empty espresso cups side-by-side.

positions.where: pausing fingers over the keyboard, glancing at the two empty espresso cups, and taking a slow breath

props.name: two empty ceramic espresso cups
props.physical_behavior: reveal the true source of the racing pulse

actions.verb_sequence: starts typing a sharp reply -> spots the two empty espresso cups -> deletes the draft calmly

reactions.reaction: shakes head lightly, saving an unnecessary argument

scenes.recognition_hook: Spotting the double espresso on your desk stops your brain from blaming your coworker for a racing pulse.
